beforePosting.text: Add the music inside each app
beforePosting.how: No music is baked into the videos. TikTok: pick a track from the Commercial Music Library. Instagram: the Meta music library. YouTube Shorts: the Shorts library. LinkedIn and X: no music. Keep it low so the sound effects still click.

beforePosting.text: Switch on the SITE, DECK and CLIENT DM keywords
beforePosting.how: Captions say "Comment SITE", "DM me DECK" and "Comment CLIENT". Turn on the Instagram comment-to-DM automation for those three words first (Instagram playbook, template t21).

beforePosting.text: Remove the "30-second uncut build" line from the DM
beforePosting.how: The keyword DM promises a 30-second uncut build, and that recording does not exist yet. Take the line out of the DM until it is recorded.

reminders.text: Post V01 before midnight, or use the _justlaunched file tomorrow
reminders.how: The V01 files say "We launched today." Post them tonight (TikTok, Instagram Reel, YouTube Shorts). From Tue 27 Oct use the _justlaunched files instead ("We just launched.") and write "We just launched Makeborne" in the captions.
